title: U.S. Southwest semiconductor workforce and supplier scaling evidence
question: Can local supplier and workforce systems support semiconductor scaling?
why_it_matters: Funded semiconductor projects only become operating capacity if labor pipelines, construction capacity, suppliers, training systems, and capital commitments can keep up.
current_support: FTFN now has operating training assets, MEP client-outcome survey data, Manufacturing USA and institute portfolios, one 47-graduate biomanufacturing program, and a Mesa facility quality and savings result.
missing_evidence: apprenticeship completion, credential, retention, and placement outcomes
training capacity relative to fab and supplier demand
facility occupation mix, vacancies, attrition, and hiring demand
candidate_records: MAG 2023 population, housing, and employment projections
TSMC apprenticeship outcome and retention data
Arizona occupation-specific labor and vacancy data
next_action: Follow engagement and completion records into credential, placement, retention, wage, vacancy, quality, throughput, customer-delivery, and productivity outcomes with compatible denominators.

named_records: NIST MEP National Network FY 2024 Results
NIST Arizona MEP Amphenol Aerospace Results
latest_review.stage_result: The workforce trail now includes survey-attributed outcomes, a named completion result, and a facility intervention. Common placement, retention, wage, vacancy, and productivity denominators remain incomplete.
latest_review.stop_rule: Do not equate engagement with completion, completion with placement, attributed savings with audited causality, or one facility with regional workforce sufficiency.

notes: Phase 55Y advances from coordination into operating training assets and delivered aggregate graduates while preserving the semiconductor-specific outcome gap.
